name: John Arrington
role: Cave Hills rancher on the Medora-Deadwood stage road
bio: John Arrington had a ranch in the Cave Hills on the stage road, where Dr. Jorgens spent Thanksgiving 1884 and the arrival of a baby in the Arrington household was reported in January 1885. In June 1885 the round-up gathered all but four of his herd of 250, and the paper called his ranch as pretty a location as any in the country.
